character_types: middle-aged wife in curly wig and glasses
visual_synopsis: A grey-haired old man lies propped up in a sickbed in a plain apartment bedroom while his wife (a male actor in a curly wig, glasses and cream cardigan) sits on a chair at the bedside and a young woman and young man sit silently on the sofa opposite. The entire sketch is his slow deathbed monologue in close-up, intercut with the three relatives' deadpan reaction shots.
